description: Anametric is developing new technologies and devices for chip-scale quantum photonics, with a focus on cybersecurity. The company enjoys a close working relationship with Southern Methodist University (SMU) in Dallas, Texas. Together, we are commercializing innovative devices based on the SMU team’s advanced research along with Anametric’s deep experience in semiconductor design and cybersecurity. Anametric is deeply involved with the quantum industry today. The company is working with the Quantum Photonics group at the Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) on novel quantum photonic chip designs. We also serve in a leadership role within the Quantum Economic Development Consortium (QED-C), a government-industry group created by the National Quantum Initiative Act of 2018. After completing primary research, we are now in the early testing stages on our unique quantum photonic (QPIC) chips. With a firm focus on cybersecurity applications and with the backing of experienced venture investors, we are developing our first generation of quantum photonic products.

Anno.ai is a defense-focused software company specializing in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) workflows to enhance national security and industrial operations. Founded by former Intelligence Community officers, the company provides an end-to-end data curation and ML platform—often described as "the GitHub for machine learning data"—that enables users to rapidly annotate, iterate, and deploy mission-oriented models across video, imagery, and audio datasets. Their core products, such as EchoDome for acoustic drone detection and Secure Campus Intelligence (SCI) for target tracking, are engineered to help warfighters and analysts overcome "the valley of death" in data exploitation by automating the discovery of operationally relevant objects in vast amounts of unstructured data. Recently acquired by NorthBridge in early 2024, Anno.ai continues to scale its presence as a critical provider of testing infrastructure and ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) solutions for the U.S. military and commercial campus security.

Arena Labs is revolutionizing the way frontline clinicians are trained for the rapidly-changing landscape of healthcare. With a team of military leaders, Olympic athletes, clinical professionals, and other experts across the world’s highest-performing disciplines, Arena Labs is the creator of the world’s first performance coaching platform for healthcare, Arena Strive. Arena Strive trains how clinicians prepare for, respond to, and recover from the chronic pressure of living on the frontlines of healthcare with three key components: data-driven methodologies backed by world-class scientists, clinicians, and experts in human performance; actionable daily practices and coaching that optimize stress, energy, and recovery management; and data insights that track changes and measure progress in clinicians’ biomarkers.

Beacon AI is building the future of flight safety for commercial and private fleets. It is a Silicon Valley-based, venture-backed company, Navy pilot veteran-founded, purpose-built startup on a mission to put AI assistance in every professional flight deck to improve flight safety and efficiency for defense and commercial aircraft operators. Beacon AI offers a novel data-based approach to AI for military and commercial aviation.
tagline: We improve flight efficiency and safety for aircraft operators by augmenting pilots

description: Since 2011, Bespoke Post has been introducing our customers to small, under-the-radar brands and quality goods through a multi-category membership service and full e-commerce shop. Whether it’s starting a fun new hobby, upgrading your personal style, tasting an unfamiliar flavor, or just finding something that makes life that little bit easier—Bespoke Post is all about discovery. Taking a tech and data-driven approach, we ensure our members are presented with curated products that align with their interests and passions, leading to enriching new experiences. Our goals have always been the same: To cut through the noise to find products with heart and soul, and to inspire curiosity and a sense of adventure in our 300k+ members. Here's how it works: at the beginning of each month, you'll get an email with a full look inside the box we've selected for you based on what we think you'll enjoy. You're free to tweak colors and sizes, add on extra goods, or skip it at no cost – whatever you want. And there's always free shipping, easy returns, and no hassles, ever. See you on the inside.
tagline: Themed Boxes for People Who Care

description: BioFlyte is an advanced biosecurity and defense technology company pioneering the next generation of automated, continuous threat detection for airborne biological hazards. BioFlyte has revolutionized critical infrastructure protection with its proprietary field-portable and fixed-sensor platforms, which utilize advanced mass spectrometry to identify aerosolized toxins, viruses, and bacteria in real time. Unlike traditional testing methods that require hours of laboratory processing, BioFlyte’s dual-use technology delivers instantaneous, actionable alerts to protect commercial airports, corporate campuses, transit hubs, and military personnel from biothreats. By replacing slow, manual collection routines with an autonomous, always-on digital shield, BioFlyte provides the resilient security infrastructure necessary to safeguard public health and fortify national security against evolving biological dangers.

Brainscape is a web and mobile study platform that helps students, educators, and corporate trainers learn faster and retain information longer. Marketed as "flashcards for serious learners," the platform breaks down complex subjects into "atomic facts" and delivers them via an adaptive learning algorithm based on cognitive science.

Casimir is a pioneering energy technology company developing the world’s first "unlimited" power supply by harvesting energy from quantum fields. Through its proprietary Casimir cavities and the upcoming Microsparc chip (slated for a 2026 launch), the company aims to eliminate the need for batteries, cords, and external charging for a wide range of applications. By utilizing advanced die-stacking and multi-layer architectures, Casimir plans to scale its technology from powering small IoT sensors and medical devices to eventually supporting electric vehicles, data centers, and aerospace infrastructure, fundamentally transforming the industrial base through autonomous, perpetual power.

Chiplytics is developing cutting-edge inspection technology to provide fast, quantifiable assurance of microelectronics during a time when counterfeit components increasingly threaten product reliability and security. Our core product is Power Spectrum Analysis, a non-invasive testing technique developed at Sandia National Laboratories that passes a signal through a chip to extract its unique electrical signature at any stage in the supply chain. We seek to combine this technology with detailed external visual inspection along with automation and AI to support a new wave of data-driven supply chain security

Citra Space Corporation is a Colorado-based defense-tech and aerospace startup founded in 2024 by former U.S. military space officers to bridge the critical "identification and characterization gaps" in Earth's increasingly crowded orbit. The company develops modular ground-based hardware sensors and advanced data-fusion software designed to move beyond basic satellite tracking, creating unique behavioral profiles that determine the exact identity, capabilities, and intent of orbital objects. Catering to both commercial operators and national security sectors.

Civitech develops technology and data products that help Democratic candidates win, progressive causes succeed, and local governments better serve their community to create a fairer, more equitable democracy. In 2020, Civitech powered voter registration and vote by mail tools for leading campaigns and advocacy organizations, and helped our clients register over 800,000 voters.

description: De-Ice is a company that provides de-icing and anti-icing services to the aviation industry. They specialize in the removal of snow, ice, and frost from aircraft, as well as the application of anti-icing fluids to prevent the formation of ice on critical surfaces. The company plays an important role in maintaining aviation safety and ensuring that flights can take off and land safely, even in adverse weather conditions.

The convergence of advanced AI & machine learning with wireless signal processing is the foundation for a new generation of smarter and more efficient wireless systems which learn and improve from data, reduce cost of ownership, and improve spectrum usage and user experience. DeepSig develops AI/ML software components and products that improve commercial and private wireless communication systems. Our team of engineers, data scientists, and computer scientists have pioneered the convergence in industry-leading ideas, software solutions, and patent development. DeepSig is building the foundation for the next generation of wireless.

EnCharge AI is a leader in advanced AI hardware and software systems for edge computing. EnCharge’s robust and scalable next-generation in-memory computing technology provides orders-of-magnitude higher compute efficiency and density compared to today’s best-in-class solutions. The high-performance architecture is coupled with seamless software integration and will enable the immense potential of AI to be accessible in power, energy, and space constrained applications. EnCharge AI launched in 2022 and is led by veteran technologists with backgrounds in semiconductor design and AI systems.
tagline: Unlocking New Levels of Machine Intelligence

description: FluxWorks is a Texas-based startup developing safe, smart, and reliable magnetic gearboxes. Our Celestial Gear™, which harnesses a non-contact design to withstand harsh environments and requires near-zero maintenance, enhances performance by driving precision and increasing machine lifetime beyond what traditional mechanical gears are capable of providing.
tagline: FluxWorks exists to redefine how machines move — with our Celestial Gear™ we deliver elegant, efficient, and contactless power transmission.

description: Havoc (HavocAI) is a defense technology company specializing in all-domain collaborative autonomy, developing modular software and software-defined hardware to orchestrate large robotic fleets across sea, air, and land. Headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island, the company's core technology—anchored by HAVOC OS—enables a single human supervisor to easily command thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets simultaneously, even in heavily contested or GPS-denied environments. With over 25,000 hours of autonomous testing, dozens of deployed systems supporting U.S. Department of Defense missions, and multiple SBIR contracts, Havoc delivers "affordable mass" and resilient, always-on edge computing to meet the modern demands of global national security.

ID.me simplifies how individuals prove and share their identity online. The ID.me secure digital identity network has 66 million members with over 145,000 new subscribers joining daily, as well as partnerships with 29 states, 10 federal agencies, and over 500 name-brand retailers. The company provides identity proofing, authentication, and group affiliation verification for organizations across sectors. The company's technology meets the federal standards for consumer authentication and is approved as a NIST 800-63-3 IAL2 / AAL2 conformant credential service provider by the Kantara Initiative. ID.me's Identity Gateway also has a Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) Moderate Authority to Operate (ATO). ID.me is the only provider with video chat and is committed to "No Identity Left Behind" to enable all people to have a secure digital identity.

Intalus is an advanced materials science company that specializes in a patented ceramic infusion process designed to revolutionize metal performance in extreme environments. Unlike traditional coatings that sit on the surface and are prone to delamination, Intalus’s technology integrates ceramics directly into the metal architecture, creating a permanent, unified material with no boundary layer. This "engineered material architecture" provides superior resistance to wear, corrosion, and thermal distortion, making it a critical solution for high-stakes industries where failure is not an option. From aerospace and satellite components to undersea exploration and additive manufacturing, Intalus enables OEMs to push the physical limits of their hardware through materials that offer permanent, built-in durability.

Operate and grow your organization with the most comprehensive youth sports management platform. Power your registration, payments, messaging, scheduling, reporting, and website design to more effectively run your clubs, camps, tournaments, and leagues. No other platform allows you to manage your operations both on and off the field or integrates with as many third-party tools.

Lonestar Data Holdings (often referred to as Lonestar) is a pioneering aerospace and data infrastructure company establishing the world's first premium, off-Earth data storage networks and orbital data centers. Lonestar is building a future for data at the edge of space, providing unparalleled "Resiliency as a Service" (RaaS) for enterprise and government clients. Following highly successful Pathfinder test flights that demonstrated data operations and edge processing from cislunar space and the lunar surface, the company is actively deploying its commercial "StarVault" platforms across multiple Earth orbits and the cislunar domain. By utilizing an independent, air-gapped space network that leverages natural solar energy, radiative cooling, and robust international space laws for unmatched data sovereignty, Lonestar successfully insulates critical terrestrial data infrastructure from catastrophic geopolitical, cyber, and environmental vulnerabilities on Earth.

Let your customers tell your story. With Olapic, you can collect, curate, create and activate visual content, driving brand engagement to new heights. Co-create with Olapic, and turn content into commerce.

The Virtuix Omni™ motion platform enables players to explore endless VR worlds, moving freely and at full speed in 360° without hitting any walls. Walk, run, and turn in 360° in virtual reality games and applications! Omniverse™, the Omni’s proprietary content platform, includes 20+ of the world’s top VR games optimized for the Omni and location-based entertainment. Omniverse transforms the Omni into a complete entertainment solution for amusement venues. Walking and running in virtual reality creates an unprecedented sense of immersion. With its small footprint and affordability, the Omni is the ultimate multiplayer VR attraction for VR arcades and family entertainment centers around the world.

Onsights (formerly known as Anno.ai) is a customer-centric retail analytics platform that leverages artificial intelligence to transform physical shopping environments into data-driven experiences. By utilizing a property’s existing security camera infrastructure—eliminating the need for new hardware—the platform tracks the complete shopper journey, providing retailers and mall operators with deep insights into visitor behavior, dwell times, and cross-shopping patterns. Their technology, which is fully CCPA- and GDPR-compliant, allows brick-and-mortar businesses to optimize store layouts, measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, and increase revenue through advanced "location intelligence" that picks up where traditional footfall counters and mobile-data solutions leave off.

PiLogic is a dual-use company revolutionizing aerospace by delivering precise, efficient, and mathematically grounded AI solutions. We provide targeted models with unparalleled accuracy and speed. PiLogic delivers exact AI models to the point of need; AI that doesn’t hallucinate and can run at the edge. Unlike traditional ML or LLMs, PiLogic models are built on Probabilistic Inference and Automated Reasoning; AI that reasons from first principles, not patterns. ‍
tagline: PiLogic is a targeted, efficient and precise AI.

description: Radical Aero is pioneering persistent, high-performance infrastructure in the stratosphere through its autonomous, solar-powered "StratoSats". Founded by Amazon Prime Air veterans, the Seattle-based company builds ultra-lightweight aircraft designed to fly continuously at 65,000 to 70,000 feet for months without landing. By filling the critical middle ground between traditional satellites and ground infrastructure, Radical’s flagship aircraft—Evenstar—boasts a 120-foot wingspan but weighs only 240 pounds, utilizing a zero-emissions, solar-recharging architecture to stay airborne indefinitely. Free from orbital constraints, these rapidly deployable, maneuverable platforms provide an inexpensive, high-resolution solution for a wide range of commercial and national-security dual-use applications, including direct-to-device 5G connectivity, maritime domain awareness, ultra-high-resolution Earth imagery, wildfire tracking, and resilient positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT).

Reaxiomatic (Reax) is bypassing the bureaucracy, high costs, and slow timelines of legacy defense contractors by revolutionizing aerospace manufacturing. Operating out of San Diego, the company applies a fast-paced, software-like iteration playbook to complex hardware engineering, radically accelerating design-to-flight testing cycles. By focusing on modern manufacturing, autonomous capabilities, and cost-effective "heavy attritables," Reaxiomatic is built to drastically scale up the production of critical defense infrastructure and deliver cutting-edge hardware to the warfighter at a fraction of the traditional time and cost.
tagline: Increasing the rate of American capability

description: Acquired by Forcepoint, RedOwl mitigates the insider threat for information security and regulatory surveillance teams. Backed by the Blackstone Group, Allegis Capital, and Conversion Capital, RedOwl is headquartered in Baltimore with offices in New York, San Francisco, and London.

Sicura, a cybersecurity and compliance automation leader, empowers organizations in regulated industries to maintain secure and compliant infrastructures. Trusted by federal agencies like Army DEVCOM and the Department of State, Sicura’s solutions reduce ATO timelines, automate compliance, and ensure secure operations across hybrid environments. With roots in the NSA, Sicura brings decades of expertise to help organizations navigate today’s complex cybersecurity landscape.

description: SightX is the first consumer insights platform where users can run any type of market research study and have automated, advanced quantitative and qualitative analysis within the same platform. Our users are empowered to own the entire research process. The speed and efficiency gains by our users are unmatched. Reducing the time for market research projects from weeks to hours allows more time for strategic thinking. With SightX, each user is able to have a greater impact on their team and organization.

Swan is a pioneering autonomous systems company dedicated to delivering the future of defense and critical infrastructure through highly scalable, software-defined autonomous products. Swan specializes in decoupling advanced autonomy software from rigid hardware frameworks, enabling multi-domain uncrewed assets to operate with unprecedented adaptability and coordination on the frontline. By leveraging cutting-edge machine learning and open-architecture edge computing, Swan transforms standard robotics and commercial vehicles into self-organizing, mission-ready tactical platforms. Trusted to deliver "affordable mass" and resilient operations in contested, communications-limited environments, Swan provides the critical, dual-use technology needed to optimize fleet readiness, protect human operators, and close strategic capability gaps for global defense and industrial enterprises alike.
tagline: Swan delivers the future of defense and industry through scalable autonomous products.

description: Swarmbotics builds ground robot swarms that provide our military’s land forces with a decisive edge on the battlefield. Their low-cost autonomous ground vehicles provide ground-breaking affordable mass, a wide array of potential payloads, and a completely new class of swarm capabilities for the future fight.

Synapse Technology Corporation is a company that develops and provides artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for a variety of industries. They specialize in computer vision, deep learning, and machine learning technologies to create AI-powered systems that can detect, analyze, and respond to real-world situations. One of Synapse Technology Corporation's key areas of focus is the security and surveillance industry. They have developed an AI-powered security system that can detect and track potential threats in real-time, using computer vision to analyze video feeds from security cameras and other sources. The system can automatically alert security personnel to potential threats, enabling faster response times and improved overall security.

Taqtile is a premier spatial computing and augmented reality (AR) software company transforming industrial workflows, frontline operations, and defense readiness. Taqtile developed Manifest®, an enterprise-grade platform that enables deskless workers and defense personnel to easily capture, share, and follow complex operational knowledge in real time. By transforming intricate maintenance routines, inspection checklists, and equipment manuals into interactive, step-by-step 3D visual instructions on AR headsets, tablets, and mobile devices, Manifest significantly reduces human error, accelerates onboarding, and enhances safety. Trusted by global manufacturing giants, commercial aviation leaders, and multiple branches of the U.S. and allied militaries, Taqtile delivers the resilient, dual-use software architecture required to optimize fleet readiness and close the industrial skills gap on the frontline.
tagline: The world’s leading augmented reality industrial software platform

description: TERN AI is an advanced positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) technology company pioneering the future of satellite-free, signal-independent vehicle navigation. Built to eliminate global mobility's critical over-reliance on GPS and GNSS infrastructure—which are increasingly vulnerable to jamming, spoofing, and environmental blockages—TERN AI delivers the world’s first Independently Derived Positioning System (IDPS™). This proprietary, software-only AI engine integrates directly with existing factory vehicle sensors and standard digital maps, enabling hyper-accurate, continuous routing through tunnels, urban canyons, and contested electronic warfare zones without requiring costly hardware such as LiDAR or cameras.

Tomahawk Robotics is a premier defense technology leader specializing in AI-enabled common control systems and integrated communication networks that redefine human-machine teaming on the modern battlefield. Tomahawk is a pioneer in interoperability across the defense sector with its flagship Kinesis Ecosystem. Kinesis is an open-architecture, platform-agnostic software solution that enables warfighters to operate and coordinate a diverse fleet of over twenty uncrewed aerial and ground vehicles from multiple manufacturers through a single, intuitive user interface. By decoupling control software from proprietary hardware and introducing rugged, body-worn edge-compute devices, Tomahawk Robotics eliminates vendor lock, delivers actionable situational awareness, and accelerates the adoption of AI-driven mission capabilities across the U.S. Department of Defense and more than 55 allied nations.

Pangiam (A BigBear.ai Company) is a premier provider of Vision AI and advanced biometric solutions built to revolutionize global trade, travel, and digital identity. By integrating Trueface—the industry’s premier, bias-mitigated facial recognition engine—alongside its robust suite of security technologies, such as veriScan™ and Project DARTMOUTH, Pangiam delivers lightning-fast, secure, and vendor-agnostic identity verification. Founded by senior federal customs and aviation security professionals and supported by elite computer vision engineers, the company excels at solving complex operational friction points for commercial airlines, international airports, and national security agencies. Now fully backed by BigBear.ai's predictive data analytics, Pangiam transforms real-time camera data into actionable intelligence, enabling a frictionless world where people and goods move securely across borders, infrastructure, and secure facilities.

UbiQD is an advanced materials company powering product innovations in agriculture, clean energy, and security. Our quantum dots enable industry leaders to harness the power of light and our first product, UbiGro®, is a layer of light that helps plants get more from the sun. At UbiQD, we know that great technologies depend on great materials. Our patented quantum dots hold the key to unlocking low-waste, high-efficiency solutions for society’s most pressing problems. By developing dots that are safe, reliable, and, affordable, UbiQD’s solutions enable a new wave of revolutionary technologies. Through green chemistry and novel manufacturing techniques, our solutions replace capital-intensive alternatives. UbiQD is headquartered in Los Alamos, NM and we are licensing technology developed at leading research institutions, including Los Alamos National Laboratory and MIT.

We drive the collaboration to predict, deliver, and pay for services that impact whole-person health. Through Unite Us’ national network and software, community-based organizations, government agencies, and healthcare organizations are all connected to better collaborate to meet the needs of the individuals in their communities.

Worldscape’s architecture collapses the time and cost of development by enabling developers to read, write, and orchestrate data in real time across public and private sources.

description: Xponent Power is a pioneering clean energy technology company specializing in highly versatile, retractable solar power solutions designed to accelerate the adoption of renewable energy across mobile and off-grid applications. Xponent Power revolutionized the outdoor recreation and automotive sectors with its flagship product, the X_Panther, the world's first commercial retractable solar awning for RVs. Engineered with an intelligent, aerodynamic design that automatically retracts during high winds to prevent damage, the platform delivers high-efficiency power generation without sacrificing mobility or durability. By eliminating the structural limitations of traditional fixed solar installations, Xponent Power is successfully expanding its disruptive, scalable solar technology into commercial trucking, maritime, residential, and emergency relief sectors, bringing resilient and sustainable energy infrastructure wherever it is needed most.
